name: bar-list

frames.best_why: Clean Pages view with all six ranked bars, labels and values, and no cursor in the way.

tagline: A ranked list of blue bars sized to each value, with a value column beside.
summary: A card ranks pages, referrers or countries as horizontal blue bars, each labelled with its name and a right-aligned count. Tabs switch the dataset and the bars resize to the new maximum.
appearance: A dark card with a total and a three-tab switcher at the top, then rows of blue horizontal bars sized by value, with a name inside each bar and a number right-aligned beside. A grey hint line sits at the bottom.
behaviour: Switching a tab swaps the dataset and the bars spring to their new widths; hovering a row brightens it, and clicking one filters the report and prints the chosen name below.
demo_content: Visitor counts by page, referrer and country, such as /home 8,430 and google.com 5,120.
use_when: A dashboard needs a compact ranking of top pages, sources or countries with share-of-total bars.
avoid_when: Values are encoded by bar width only against the max, so small entries look almost empty and there is no axis.
customise: Pass a data array of name, value and optional href, plus valueFormatter, sortOrder, showAnimation and onValueChange. Colours are fixed blue and the row layout is in the source.
weight_why: A short list of divs with CSS width transitions; nothing runs between interactions.

a11y.note: Rows are real buttons with focus rings and aria-sort, but each button exposes only the name, not its value, and widths animate regardless of motion settings.

issues: The value sits in a separate column, so a focused row button announces only the name.
polish_why: Clean, readable ranking with tidy tabs and bars; ordinary styling and a detached value column.
title: Bar List
